decision: Continue live render-worker integration; no install or gameplay FPS claim.

validation.full_production_suite: Passed at da85d4e; not repeated for this optional test-only extension.

measurement_contract: Producer creates hidden window/device/resources and independent reference images. MULTITHREADED is required before worker startup.
Exclusive drawing handoff uses test-only timing/instancer thread-ID transfers after complete initialization, returned after worker completion.
Producer pumps window messages while collecting completions. Window procedure dispatches ordered markers and makes no D3D calls.
Producer captures native matrix values plus generated opacity/diffuse/time values and a fixed texture index for all three modes.
Direct mode generates native bone endpoints on the worker; serial-copy and pipeline modes generate them on the producer and copy owned palettes.
All completion measurements include copies, backpressure, message handling, multithreaded locking and GPU drains. No external Accelerator DLL is used.
Regular/extra pairs model one lit or shadow pass. Savings cannot be added or converted into game FPS.

source_audit.reset_finding: Reset_Device releases asset resources before calling D3D Reset; a worker drain must precede native teardown.
source_audit.recall: OpenViking endpoint refused connection; engineering-search returned no results. Existing reference checkout reused read-only.

lines: loaded 1386 ms after process start, pinned=1
startup_evidence.limit: One captured startup path; not a guarantee that every loader attaches before device creation.

integration_failures_found: Initial handoff failed the timing owner guard; after its exclusive transfer, the independent instancer owner guard also refused work.
Images then matched but vertex constant word 744 differed: expected 3F666666, actual 3F666667. Re-evaluating synthetic opacity on the worker changed the value.
Copied producer-evaluated material values fix the exact state mismatch without modifying floating-point controls.
The first corrected pilot stopped in a runner classification bug before the device-flags process. Final runs use the corrected runner and exclude all pilots.
limits: Native creation-body semantics do not inspect an actual live device or an external backend override.
Timing/instancer ID-transfer helpers are exclusive fixture operations, not a live solution for concurrent frame/render ownership.
Fixed texture indices and stable fixture resources do not prove live COM ownership, generations, mutation or eviction.
43,200 vector decodes per draw use synthetic warm cursors; count and distribution are not captured gameplay animation work.
Native source families beyond matrix callbacks, effect identity/Begin results, full scene, UI, reflection, Present and network matches remain unqualified.
No Reset or final device-release qualification. The legacy fixture leaves resource leaks to process exit; this does not establish production destruction.
Separate process samples cannot isolate MULTITHREADED overhead from workload/time drift.
No runtime code, installed ASI/INI, stable release or gameplay behavior changed.
